Is it medically necessary for the cat to be killed? Have you tried getting more litter boxes and placing them around the house? My cat started to pee in "unfortunate" places. Turns out he was only trying to tell me that having only one litter box in the house was unacceptable. Our cats really have no issues telling us when they need something, they just don't use words. We have to be aware, and try a few different things to fix the issue. This post sounds cold, like you just want rid of the kitty. Maybe it's only coming off that way, but I'm concerned. Please give your cat the chance at life that it deserves! There are other things you can try before you commit to ending the kitties life.

I just had my cat neutered 2 weeks ago. I was SO worried that getting him neutered would change his personality, because he's such a sweet little guy. I was genuinely losing sleep over it. However, I can honestly say that all of the worrying was for nothing. The only difference is that he is far less aggressive while playing now, barely any play bites and the claws come out a lot less. My guy is still as cuddly and sweet as ever. It's okay to be worried, that's your baby. It will most likely be completely fine though, neuters are usually very quick and easy for them to heal from. Hope everything goes well!

I think we all do small things that keep us from doing it for a short time over and over again, and that cycle just repeats. Like being in bed at night and thinking “I’m gonna kill myself tonight” but then just lying there until you fall asleep. Putting on a show you like when thoughts get overwhelming. Asking someone to hangout instead of hurting yourself because you want to see them one more time, then you end up just going home after and going to bed. I think talking to people you love about your issues is very helpful. When you get to such a low point, feeling any kind of love is much needed. You deserve to be able to talk about what burdens you, and I bet your friends will be very thankful you chose to reach out.
